description_en: Queries the price difference for a plan specification change by calling DescribeRatePlanPriceGap
description_zh: 调用DescribeRatePlanPriceGap查询套餐变配差价
name: DescribeRatePlanPriceGap

parameters.help_en: The target plan name. You can obtain this value from the [DescribeRatePlanPrice](~~DescribeRatePlanPrice~~) operation
parameters.help_zh: 目标套餐名称，从[DescribeRatePlanPrice](~~DescribeRatePlanPrice~~)接口查询获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The code of the target plan for the specification change
parameters.name: target_plan_code

parameters.help_en:
The specification change type. Valid values:
DOWNGRADE: downgrade.
UPGRADE: upgrade
parameters.help_zh:
变配类型：
DOWNGRADE：降配。
UPGRADE：升配
parameters.name: order_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the target plan for the specification change
parameters.name: target_plan_name
